_comment: Pinned inputs for the codeview asset and language-map generators (feature 070). Changing a version here is a deliberate, reviewed act: regenerate with tools/codeview/build_web.py + gen_langmap.py and review the resulting diff, including web/licence-manifest.json.

linguist._comment: GitHub Linguist data used by gen_langmap.py. linguist-languages repackages languages.yml as JSON; heuristics.yml is fetched from the tagged revision below.

_minimum_grammars_note: SC-001 requires at least 200 highlighted languages; build_web.py fails if the licence audit leaves fewer.
